prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished original MiraiTV app icon inspired by the visual language of the TWO reference images: bold flat anime mascot graphics, expressive oversized eye shapes, a white TV-shaped face with dark navy hair, clean high contrast, playful silhouette, simple vector-like geometry. The reference images are STYLE REFERENCES only, not assets to copy exactly. Design an original friendly anime TV mascot: a gently rounded white television face, two short diagonal antenna tips on top, a sweeping asymmetrical dark navy anime fringe, one very large sparkling navy-and-violet oval eye on the right and a small cheerful wink on the left, two short violet blush strokes, and a small violet triangular play-shaped smiling mouth integrated near the lower center. Use only white, near-black navy #18132e, and a consistent bright lavender-violet #9562e8. Place it on a saturated violet rounded-square app tile, with generous corner rounding like the references. The tile should extend to all four edges of the square canvas; ONLY the small areas outside its rounded corners should be genuinely transparent, never white. Mascot fits comfortably inside with enough padding for antennae, easy to recognize at 28px and as a mobile app icon. The main white silhouette occupies about 70 percent of the tile width. Crisp, perfectly clean flat vector-like edges, flat fills, strong negative space. No text or letters, no wordmark, no gradients, no 3D rendering, no mockup, no shadows, no texture, no realistic portrait, no additional symbols, no multiple variants or contact sheet. Output a single polished square icon.
